text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On my day off, I visited the zoo with Wonder Acute.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hohoho, so many customers.
It's quite lively, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That's true. For now,
shall we follow where everyone else is heading?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After going with the flow for a while,
Wonder Acute suddenly came to a stop.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Howaa~~...
Now ain't this just the cutest~...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What they were looking at
were capybaras relaxing by the water.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Mr. Capybara looks so heartwarming.
He's staying completely still... is he sleepy, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
This is so soothing... It's making me
sleepy too~... *yaaaawn*—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Wait, is she okay?
Isn't Acute-san about to completely fall asleep!?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: ...Wha?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Well, I can see why they'd get sleepy.
These kids have such peaceful looks on their faces.
choice_data_list: Were you all watching the capybaras too?
Were you watching the capybaras too?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: "Nah, it's more like, I was worried Acute was gonna nod off."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Fufu, thank you for worrying about me.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I kinda feel a kinship with Mr. Capybara.
I could just watch him forever, you know...?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: *Yaaawn*...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, she's asleep!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah. If you like it that much, want me to take a picture?
A two-shot with the capybara.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Two-sho...? I don't really get it, but... in that case, please do take a picture of us.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Snap!)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my! What a lovely photo~!
I look just like a capybara, don't I~?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Nice. This is legit so soothing.
Feels like it could totally work as a power spot.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Power spot...?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
It's like seeing it brings good luck.
You can really feel the warm vibes coming off it.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Totally! It looks super cute,
so let's post it on Umastagram.
On my account, cool?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, it's the famous Umastagram!
Sure thing, let's give this Umastagram a shot~

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Alright. So how should we filter it?
Wanna go all out with the effects?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I think it looks nice just like this with its natural vibe, though.
choice_data_list: Let's show them who you really are.
Let's try making it more impressive!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, Mr. Capybara looks
so content.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Let's make sure everyone gets to enjoy
this heartwarming atmosphere.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And then—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Oh! Already got a comment. Let's see...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"‘So soothing~’ ‘This is a real power spot!’
‘My sluggishness vanished completely!’ it says!"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, everyone's thinking the exact same thing.
I kinda like that.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, I'm so glad.
I'm happy you enjoyed the power spot.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The photo of Wonder Acute and the capybara seemed to be very well-received as a soothing picture.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Fufufu, yes indeed. Since I have the chance, perhaps I'll give it a try.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
All right, leave it to me!
I'll load it up with tons of effects~~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And then—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Oh! Already got a comment. Let's see...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"‘Acute-chan with all those filters is insane!
So precious! Saved immediately!’ it says!"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Ah, true. Might be the first time I've seen it too. Pretty shocking, honestly.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, somehow this is quite fun.
Maybe I'll have them pile it high for me again.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The unexpected photo of Wonder Acute seemed to be received quite favorably.
